evidence.limits: No whisper.srt when coded: words come from burned-in captions (hook 0-5 s complete at 4 fps; later sampled once a second so words between samples are missed). Whether the host's reaction shots (red cap) are the host speaking or listening is read from mouth movement only. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Podcast clip: 'don't go to school', the education ministry will interfere; learn from YouTube, books, people, and school grades and matriculation are irrelevant; ends with 'there is no personal file'.
audience: teenagers and parents, aspiring entrepreneurs who doubt the school system
caption_vs_video_note: Caption warns 'צפו עד הסוף לפני שאתם נכנסים לי לחרדות ופחדים' and ends with 'ואין דבר כזה תיק אישי, המורים משקרים לכם': matches the video's closing, which is the 'personal file' claim at about 1:08-1:10.

editing.edit_function: The clips illustrate nearly every phrase (a library for learning, a triangle for school math, money, parties for friends, books); host cutaways add reaction and humour; light-leak transitions at 38 s and 51 s mark shifts; a pop-up emblem at 3.75 s marks the ministry.

t=60-75 s: slow down to one talking-head angle with fewer inserts

editing.loop: partial: ends on the same 'school lies' idea as the opening
editing.rewatch_reasons: interpretation: strong stance, many quick pictures, an emotional close; the caption warns to watch to the end.

sound.delivery: Fast and intense speech; the transcript has no speech from 37.7 to 48.3 s (10.6 s) although the loudness data shows no silence there, so Whisper probably missed it (speech unclear in that stretch); continuous again to 1:14.
sound.sync: Caption words change per phrase and the clips are timed to the keyword of each phrase ('מחשב', 'כסף', 'ספרים'); red marks negatives and warnings, green marks positive actions.

text.colour_coding: White main, red for prohibitions and warnings ('אל תקשיבו!', 'לא רלוונטים!', 'עובדים עליכם!'), green for positive actions ('רוצים ללמוד!', 'קצת NLP'), yellow-orange for the host's lines.
text.placement: Centre of the frame, about 55% height, one short line.
text.style: Bold white sans-serif with dark outline, no box.
text.density_and_read_time: One to five words per caption, changing about every second; easy to read.
text.language: Blunt imperatives and a list: 'אל תקשיבו! אל תשתפו פעולה!'; challenges teachers directly.
text.caption_structure: Two lines: a warning to watch to the end ('לפני שאתם נכנסים לי לחרדות ופחדים') and a closing claim; emoji; no hashtags, no CTA.
text.rtl_notes: A quotation mark is placed at the wrong side in a caption at 2.25 s ('”אל תלכו לבית הספר“'); the abbreviation 'תרפ"ט' shows correctly.

story.setup: 'Don't go to school', the host's doubt 'ממש ככה?', then he says that line is problematic because the Education Ministry and parents would interfere, and offers 'the tool': attend school but do not listen or study there (transcript 3.5 to 9 s).
story.stakes: Parents and the ministry will interfere; the grades and matriculation do not count.
story.progression: Do not listen, do not cooperate; learn on YouTube, develop hearing; learn what you want (relevant); be more social; money, NLP, nutrition, training; look for friends who are strong; read books; the 'reasons' parents will not help; grades and matriculation are irrelevant; no personal file exists.
story.payoff: The claim that 'there is no personal file' with the 'they lie to you' close.
story.resolution: Anger at people who still believe.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the closing claim is stated but only the caption explains it
friction_points: t=11-43 s: many third-party clips replace his face for a long stretch (interpretation)
t=60-70 s: 'personal file' appears with no earlier setup in the video itself (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Approximate hand count over 44 sampled comments. Strongly split: parents and teachers criticise ('חוסר אחריות', 'אתה חרפה לנוער'), others agree ('איתך 100%', 'מערכת בפשיטת רגל'). Some say there is a personal file ('יש כזה דבר תיק אישי'). The sample is not representative of 601 comments.

rights_and_privacy: Heavy third-party content: several film or TV clips with recognisable actors, a social-media clip of a couple (identifiable), a pile-of-dollars clip, the state emblem of Israel's Education Ministry. A second adult (host) shown. This limits what LumeBook can copy.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: an extreme stance in the first frame, a rapid sequence of pictures for each phrase, and a pair of voices (host doubt, his answer) make it feel like a short film; the 'film clips + captions' style keeps attention. Likes per 1,000 views (29.5) and shares per 1,000 (9.7) are high in the dossier.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: polarising claim that parents and teachers push back on; rights-heavy clips.

standout_moments.what: Red imperative 'אל תלכו לבית הספר!' on the first frame, same as the cover.
Host reaction cutaway 'ממש ככה?' adds a second voice immediately.
Education Ministry emblem pops in on cue.
Closing claim 'אין דבר כזה תיק אישי'.
